mapper.select: SELECT q.id,q.bank_id,q.question_type,q.stem,q.answer_text,q.analysis,q.tags,q.source,q.difficulty,pq.score,q.sort_no,q.status FROM test_paper_question pq JOIN question_item q ON q.id=pq.question_id WHERE pq.paper_id=#{paperId} ORDER BY pq.sort_no ASC,pq.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper_question WHERE paper_id=#{paperId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score),0) FROM test_paper_question WHERE paper_id=#{paperId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_paper_question WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_paper_question SET score=#{score} WHERE paper_id=#{paperId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
